A '''clone navigation officer''' served under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Even Piell/Legends|Even Piell]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] during the events of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
During an attack by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces on [[Even Piell's cruiser/Legends|Even Piell's cruiser]], this [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Clone navigation officer/Legends|naval officer]] was taken along with Piell and several other surviving crew members and transferred to a prison known as [[Citadel/Legends|The Citadel]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lola Sayu/Legends|Lola Sayu]].

===Battle of Lola Sayu===
Due to the knowledge Piell had on the [[Nexus Route/Legends|Nexus Route]], an elite strike team lead by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] entered the prison to rescue Piell. When the team learned that Piell had given part of the information to [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]], a new plan was devised so that Tarkin and the other officers could also be rescued. Deciding to spilt up to better protect the information, this naval officer went with Kenobi's team. Escaping through a ventilation hatch to reach the outside of the prison, the naval officer reached a landing platform with the rest of the group but was taken prisoner by the Citadel's warden, [[Osi Sobeck/Legends|Osi Sobeck]]. With help from [[R2-D2's battle droid squadron/Legends|R2-D2's battle droid squadron]], the naval officer and Kenobi's team got back to the shuttle and a firefight ensued once the droids learned of the prisoners escape with re-programmed battle droids. The naval officer took cover with the rest of the group and when Skywalker's forces re-joined the team, the naval officer witnessed the death of [[Echo/Legends|CT-21-0408]] and the destruction of the shuttle. The naval officer retreated and continued to a landing point where [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] would pick up any survivors. To track down the survivors, Sobeck released a pack of [[Anooba/Legends|Anoobas]] and [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|Single Trooper Aerial Platforms]] to hunt down the group. While Piell and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] were fending off [[LM-432 crab droid/Legends|LM-432 crab droids]], the clones went to assist Kenobi and Skywalker in battle. When a STAP began to fire down at Tarkin, the naval officer pushed Tarkin out of the way and took the shots himself, killing him.
